title: 踏步保持轻松
description: 成人在普通地面自然踏步，身旁是已收好的攀岩装备。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult takes relaxed marching steps on a flat clear floor beside a closed gear bag and rolled mat. Capture one heel rising with the knee only slightly lifted and the opposite arm swinging, while posture remains upright and easy. A bright gym window and plain wall give the scene spaciousness. The action should look comfortable enough for conversation, avoiding fast running, timed challenges, sweat drama, or exhaustion. Use colored-pencil illustration with visible directional marks, soft graphite structure, and a quiet sage, blue, and brick palette. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
